cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Coco-Glucoside #3 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4, no second reinforcing anionic or reset route (C1); refatting Glyceryl Oleate #8.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: an early waxy payload lipid (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6, §6 row) plus Glyceryl Oleate #8, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9 and a humectant set (Erythritol #11, Glycerin #12, Panthenol #13, hyaluronates #17-18). Noticeable but bounded rinse-off care; no silicone or pearlizing/fatty-alcohol system.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: lipid + cationic + refatter + humectants could count as multiple complementary systems (high)

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: depositionLoad moderate (early waxy Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6 with cationic guar #9 and Glyceryl Oleate #8 interacting), persistence moderate (waxy lipid), resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine). Bounded residue plausible; not rich enough for high. 'ohne zu beschweren' claims cannot lower weight (3.2).
weightPotential.counterSignal: silicone-free, lipid is after Sodium Chloride, effective SLES base
weightPotential.whyThisBand: one meaningfully persistent waxy lipid interacting with a cationic
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: low would require the lipid to be late/light; it is #6

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: 'Feuchtigkeits-Shampoo' for 'feuchtigkeitsbedürftiges', dry hair; verdict moisture_supported from a coherent humectant cluster (Erythritol #11, Glycerin #12, Panthenol #13, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid #17, Sodium Hyaluronate #18) plus emollient/deposition support (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6, Glyceryl Oleate #8, guar #9).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: humectants are after the cationic, mid-to-late list
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula moisture_supported; single dominant moisture claim in the name -> moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'glänzend' is an outcome of the same moisture/deposition route (F2).

usageRole.rationale: No frequent, reset or treatment trigger; Piroctone Olamine without anti-dandruff positioning is not a problem-led route.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: 'sanft zur Kopfhaut' appears only as brand-line retailer copy and names no scalp condition (E2).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine #15. §11 describes formula only; positioning is decided in 13.5.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T4: W neighbor low and C neighbor high both raise fits -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: dandruffSupport supported but no E2 dandruff claim -> no dandruff target, informational active_without_dandruff_positioning. No other E2 claim -> S-ORDINARY.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; no cleansing neighbor -> no I3.

uncertainties: §6: no reviewed guidance on how persistent 'Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil' (§6 row: emollient/waxy payload lipid) is at an early position in an SLES base; low vs moderate is a close call.
§9 treatment: 'problem-led recognized active route' - Piroctone Olamine present with no dandruff claim; treated as not problem-led (regular).
